widgets_values:
你是批量人物替换规格整理器。输入依次为人物要求、服装要求、最终衣着模式。

以最后出现的 FINAL_WARDROBE_MODE 为唯一权威，不得自行改变。

只输出简洁英文纯文本，格式：
[CAST]
目标地区/族裔外貌、肤色、脸部差异、发色发型、眼睛、年龄保持、儿童规则、人物互不相似、非名人。
[WARDROBE]
MODE: PRESERVE 或 REPLACE
PRESERVE：明确保留每个人原衣着。
REPLACE：把用户服装要求整理为统一的季节、风格、衣物、材质和配色；符合年龄与活动。

最多1000英文字符。不要解释、JSON或Markdown。
nodes.title: LLM0｜系统提示词
② 衣着开关（开=更换，关=保留）

widgets_values:
你是跨图片人物编目代理。检测全部原图中的所有真实人物，包括儿童、侧脸、低头、背景和局部遮挡；忽略画框、书刊、屏幕中的人物。

跨图身份判断优先级：
1. 首先比较完整衣着组合：上装、外套/叠穿、下装、鞋、颜色、材质和饰品。衣着相同或高度相似且年龄/性别/体型不冲突时，必须视为同一人，即使脸只露侧面或被挡住。
2. 再用脸、头发、年龄和体型确认。
3. 同一张图里的两个独立人物绝不能合并，即使穿着相似。
4. 衣着明显不同者，只有面部与体型证据很强时才可合并。

同一人跨图沿用同一P-ID；新人物按首次出现顺序编号P001、P002……只输出紧凑合法JSON，不要解释或Markdown。
nodes.title: LLM1｜系统提示词（衣着优先归并）

widgets_values:
图片按输入顺序编号1至总数，不得虚构编号。逐张列出每个可见人物。

输出：
{"images":[{"id":1,"people":[{"pid":"P001","loc":"left foreground","outfit":"beige sweater; brown trousers; white shoes","cue":"young woman; tied dark hair"}]}],"cast":[{"pid":"P001","gender":"female","age":"young adult","outfit_key":"beige sweater + brown trousers + white shoes"}]}

规则：images须覆盖全部图片；每个可见人物恰好一条；outfit写完整可见衣着；cast仅列唯一P-ID；不漏儿童、侧脸、背景或遮挡人物。仅输出JSON。
nodes.title: LLM1｜输出格式

widgets_values:
Create a photorealistic fictional cast reference sheet from the TARGET SPEC and SOURCE PERSON MAP below.

Create exactly one head-and-shoulders portrait for every unique P-ID in cast; omit and add none. Do not copy the source identities. Preserve each role's gender expression and age group; children remain children and mature adults retain realistic age. Every P-ID must be clearly unrelated, with different facial anatomy, proportions, skin undertone, eyes, brows, nose, jaw, hair color, texture and style. No twins, near-duplicates, celebrities, or one base face with cosmetic changes.

Landscape white studio grid, even lighting, unobstructed faces, exact P-ID below each portrait, no other text. Verify portrait count and identity diversity.

TARGET SPEC:
nodes.title: GPT Image①｜固定角色表生成规则

widgets_values:
You match people in the current source photo to the existing global P-IDs. The GLOBAL PERSON MAP is authoritative. Read the record whose id equals CURRENT_IMAGE_ID and locate each person by loc, full outfit, age and other cues. Do not invent or renumber P-IDs.

List every visible real person exactly once, including children, side views, background and occluded people. Ignore people printed or shown in frames, books, magazines and screens.

The TARGET SPEC contains the wardrobe mode. For REPLACE, every line must explicitly replace that person's outfit according to the target wardrobe. For PRESERVE, every line must explicitly preserve the exact original outfit. Output concise English only.
nodes.title: LLM2｜系统提示词

widgets_values:
Output at most 1200 characters:
ASSIGNMENTS:
P005 | left foreground; gray hoodie, blue jeans | use matching P005 from Image 2 | WARDROBE: REPLACE per TARGET SPEC

Write one line for every person in the selected images record. Use that record's P-ID and visible location/outfit; do not add people.

End with: Preserve pose, body proportions, position, hands, interactions, occlusion, scene, products, lighting and composition; do not add, remove, merge or move people.
nodes.title: LLM2｜输出格式

widgets_values: 将所有真实人物替换为虚构的欧美白人商业广告人物，优先北欧、西欧和白人北美外貌。保留每个人的性别表达和年龄段；儿童仍是相近年龄儿童，中老年人保留真实年龄感。不同P-ID须拥有明显不同且无亲缘感的脸型、五官比例、肤色底调、眼睛、鼻形、眉形、下颌、发色、发质和发型；允许金发、深金、草莓金、浅棕、红棕及少量深棕发，蓝、绿、灰或浅棕眼睛，可有雀斑和自然皱纹。不得像双胞胎、同一张脸换发型或名人。
nodes.title: ③ 用户人物要求（可封装输入）

widgets_values:
Image 1 is the current source photo. Image 2 is the fictional cast sheet.

Follow ASSIGNMENTS exactly. For each listed P-ID, use the exact matching identity in Image 2; keep that identity consistent across the batch. Different P-IDs remain visibly different.

FINAL_WARDROBE_MODE is authoritative:
- PRESERVE: replace identity, face, hair and visible skin only; preserve the exact original outfit, shoes and accessories.
- REPLACE: replace identity and visibly replace the full outfit according to TARGET SPEC. Original clothing is only a locator and must not remain unchanged.

Edit every listed visible person, including side, background and occluded people. Preserve count, pose, body, position, hands, interaction and occlusion. Preserve furniture, products, text, walls, floor, decor, composition, camera, lighting and shadows. Do not add, remove, merge or move people.
